Images fetched from the LAC image server with curl -L (about half the requests need a retry).

Decoded with the table and its context-corrected cells (key/overrides.json); 1 groups sit on a cell still doubtful and 32 are cut at the gutter; the decode reads as French throughout but no reader has reviewed it as sentences.

Reader review: fetched all five images and compared every line with the transcription; corrected 353->553 (obser), 381->581 (faire), 613->615 (em); the figures 1o 2o 3o and 27 were being decoded as cells. Wrote reading.md, reading_en.md, reading_notes.md.

Cut groups at the gutter supplied from the visible digits and the sense (471 e, 328 ne, 467 ti, 246 leur, 642 de, 483 lu, 389 m); 11 groups unread (the memorandum described as 2o on f.68v, 'j'aurois [?] Monseigneur effectué', 'les [?] [?] de la douceur').

texts.label: ANOM, COL C11A 104, ff.68-72 (CABAC_PIAF_60892)
texts.summary: Vaudreuil sends the minister Montcalm's letter of 27 February, a memorandum and his own plan of operations; Montcalm's opinions had become public among officers and people, and Vaudreuil, asking Montcalm to stop it, says he would otherwise arrest the officers concerned and send them to France; he has told Montcalm he is to command at Carillon.

reading_review.by: Claude Sonnet 5.5 (a model reading, not a person), after the solving passes
reading_review.note: Read the French sentence by sentence against reading_en.md and the images: the whole letter builds coherent 1759 chancery French (Montcalm's opinions public among officers and people, the measures Vaudreuil takes, the request that officers be sent to France if need be, the instruction that Montcalm command at Carillon). Three groups corrected on the image, 11 unread, seven gutter-cut groups supplied by sense. Not checked by a person.

outcome.notes: Read as sentences against the images on 5 Nov 2026 (model reading, no outside reader). Key found, not recovered; table cells read from the images of the volume.
